contentPattern.structure: One row per milestone: cell 1 = date (one line, or a small label line such as 'Monday' followed by the date line; leave empty to continue the previous date), cell 2 = description (optional heading plus text/links). Option key-dates: a white card; an optional first single-cell row is the header (a short label line such as 'For domestic students' shown as an outlined chip, then a heading such as 'Key dates'); each following row is date | description (bold title), rendered with a calendar icon, description above the uppercase date.
